preconditions.description: The number of strings n must be between 1 and 30.

preconditions.expression: all(isinstance(s, str) for s in A)
preconditions.description: All elements in the list A must be strings.
The length of the list A must be equal to n.

postconditions.expression: stdout == str(sum(f(L) for L in contiguous_sublists(A)))
postconditions.description: The output must be the sum of f(L) for all nonempty contiguous sublists L of A.
The function f(L) must return 1 if L is stable, otherwise 0.

postconditions.expression: is_stable(L) == all(is_good_message(m) for m in SX)
postconditions.description: A list L is stable if and only if every message in SX is good.
